name: Dryad

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.desc: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, then uses Spellcasting if able.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: Charisma (spell save DC 14). At will: Animal Friendship, Charm Monster, Druidcraft. 1/day each: Entangle, Pass without Trace.

bonusActions.name: Tree Stride
bonusActions.desc: The dryad steps into a living tree and out of another within 60 feet.

desc: The spirit of an old tree. Kind to those who respect the grove; the rest get lost and are never quite found.
